title: Options Depth
summary: Simplifying trading for all, innovating strategy empowers users to earn like seasoned professionals.
coverAlt: Options Depth trading dashboard on a laptop

widgets.body: OptionsDepth turns a very large, very fast-moving stream of market data into something traders can actually read and act on. Its users range from hobbyists trading on their phones to professional desks at investment banks.

items.title: The screen kept turning into a control panel
items.body: The data was enormous — dozens of ways to slice it, refreshing every 60 seconds. Left alone, every view became a wall of controls with a small chart buried inside.

items.title: Beginners and professionals needed the same tool
items.body: Neither group could be given a watered-down version, and splitting into two products wasn't an option. One interface had to serve both.

widgets.caption: [ 2.1 Home page featuring the latest trends and market stories. ]

widgets.title: My Contribution
items: Designed the core screens of the platform.
Built a modular dashboard where users assemble their own workspace.
Created the component system shared across every view.

items.title: Preset Picker
items.body: New users start from a setup other traders already use, instead of a blank screen. Beginners get something that works on day one without removing anything experts rely on.

items.title: Building your dashboard
items.body: Users drag and drop widgets to build a workspace, then save up to five and switch between them by situation — the same person needs a different setup in the morning than in the afternoon.

items.title: Advanced filtering
items.body: Six separate controls were grouped into three questions — who, what, and when — so narrowing the data feels like asking something rather than operating a machine.

items.title: Multi view monitoring
items.body: Two views of the same thing on purpose: one for quick reading during a trade, a 3D one for understanding the shape before it.

items.title: External APIs
items.body: Professionals prefer raw data over charts. Instead of just adding an export feature, we created API access as a standalone product, catering to both data readers and analysts.

items.title: Other Features
items.body: In addition to these robust features, there are numerous minor and supplementary functionalities aimed at enhancing the trading experience.

title: Prosper Architecture
summary: A refined digital presence for an architecture studio—designed to present projects with clarity, hierarchy, and a calm editorial rhythm.
coverAlt: Prosper Architecture website on a laptop

widgets.body: The studio needed a site that felt as considered as the spaces they design—large imagery, restrained type, and a clear path from project discovery to booking a call.

items.title: Discover the studio's voice
items.body: Layouts lean on generous negative space and strong project photography so the work can carry the page.

items.title: Structure the journey
items.body: Navigation stays light. CTAs are deliberate companions to the project story rather than competing with it.

widgets.title: Space, rhythm, and restraint
widgets.body: The result is a calmer editorial rhythm where architecture photography leads and interface chrome stays out of the way.

title: The Dot Theory
summary: A calm healthcare and wellness portal that helps members navigate treatments, memberships, and upcoming appointments with confidence.
coverAlt: Dot Portal wellness dashboard on a laptop

widgets.body: Members needed a clear home base—what’s next, what’s available, and how memberships connect to treatments—without feeling clinical or overwhelming.

widgets.title: Warmth with structure
widgets.body: The interface uses soft surfaces and a restrained accent system so status, pricing, and packs stay scannable.

items.title: No urgency, anywhere
items.body: Greeting and appointment cues make the experience personal without clutter or pressure.

items.title: A member is greeted, not marketed to
items.body: Treatment packs and memberships are presented as clear product cards—easy to compare, easy to act on.

items.title: One question at a time
items.body: Flows stay paced so members never face a wall of decisions at once.
